name: lappy-desktop-commander-v3
description: Operate Lappy through the self-hosted VeraMesh/VeraPort connector with filesystem and managed-process tools.

interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT and Codex directly to Patrick's self-hosted VeraMesh/VeraPort MCP endpoint. The live MCP tools/list is authoritative, including the currently granted filesystem and managed-process schema; this release intentionally does not bind the stale V2 Apps SDK app.
capabilities: Inspect and edit authorized files on Lappy
Start and inspect long-running managed processes
Read process output and provide process input
Use fenced VeraPort lanes and verification
defaultPrompt: Inspect Lappy and continue the active work using the self-hosted connector.
Run the required command on Lappy, inspect its output, and verify the result.
Use separate fenced lanes for independent Lappy tasks when useful.
